senses.zh: 地球的半球；大腦的半球

examples.en: Taiwan is in the northern hemisphere, so our winter comes in December.
examples.zh: 台灣位於北半球，所以我們的冬天在十二月。

examples.en: Australia lies in the southern hemisphere, where the seasons are reversed.
examples.zh: 澳洲位於南半球，那裡的季節正好相反。

examples.en: Each hemisphere of the brain controls one side of the body.
examples.zh: 大腦的每一個半球控制身體的一側。

examples.en: The firefighter was praised for his heroic rescue of the child.
examples.zh: 那位消防員因英勇救出孩子而受到稱讚。

examples.en: It was a heroic effort to finish the marathon in the rain.
examples.zh: 在雨中跑完馬拉松，是一番艱苦卓絕的努力。

examples.en: The movie tells a heroic story about a girl who saves her village.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個女孩拯救自己村莊的英雄故事。

examples.en: The doctor gave a talk about the dangers of heroin to the students.
examples.zh: 醫師向學生演講，談海洛因的危害。

examples.en: The police found heroin hidden in a suitcase at the airport.
examples.zh: 警方在機場的一只行李箱裡發現了海洛因。

examples.en: Heroin is an illegal drug in most countries around the world.
examples.zh: 海洛因在世界上大多數國家都是違禁毒品。

examples.en: The survey asked whether the people were heterosexual or not.
examples.zh: 這份調查詢問受訪者是不是異性戀。

examples.en: A heterosexual couple can marry in many countries.
examples.zh: 異性戀伴侶在許多國家都可以結婚。

examples.en: Some heterosexual men and women joined the parade to support equal rights.
examples.zh: 一些異性戀的男性和女性加入遊行，支持平等權利。

examples.en: The study included both heterosexuals and gay people.
examples.zh: 這項研究同時包含異性戀者與同志。

examples.en: Many heterosexuals attended the event as friends and supporters.
examples.zh: 許多異性戀者以朋友和支持者的身分參加了這場活動。

examples.en: The poll compared the opinions of heterosexuals with those of other groups.
examples.zh: 這項民調比較了異性戀者與其他族群的意見。

examples.en: There is a clear hierarchy in most large companies.
examples.zh: 大多數大公司都有明確的階層制度。

examples.en: The manager sits at the top of the hierarchy in our office.
examples.zh: 經理在我們辦公室的階層裡位居最高。

examples.en: Students learned about the hierarchy of needs in psychology class.
examples.zh: 學生在心理學課上學到了需求層次。

examples.en: My voice was hoarse after I cheered at the game all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我整個下午在比賽中加油，聲音都啞了。

examples.en: Her voice became hoarse after she caught a cold last week.
examples.zh: 她上週感冒後，聲音變得沙啞。

examples.en: The teacher spoke in a hoarse voice and kept drinking water.
examples.zh: 老師用沙啞的聲音說話，還一直喝水。

examples.en: The report discusses the rights of homosexual couples in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這份報告討論台灣同性伴侶的權利。

examples.en: Taiwan is the first place in Asia to recognize homosexual marriage.
examples.zh: 台灣是亞洲第一個承認同性婚姻的地方。

examples.en: The school teaches students to respect homosexual and heterosexual classmates equally.
examples.zh: 學校教導學生平等尊重同性戀與異性戀的同學。

examples.en: The author wrote a book about the lives of homosexuals in the city.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一本書，談這座城市裡同性戀者的生活。

examples.en: Many homosexuals joined the march to ask for equal rights.
examples.zh: 許多同性戀者加入遊行，要求平等的權利。

examples.en: The law now protects homosexuals from unfair treatment at work.
examples.zh: 這項法律現在保護同性戀者在工作上不受不公平的對待。

examples.en: The university gave him an honorary degree for his work.
examples.zh: 大學因他的貢獻而頒給他榮譽學位。

examples.en: She was made an honorary member of the club.
examples.zh: 她獲授這個社團的名譽會員身分。

examples.en: Our school has an honorary chairman who visits every year.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一位名譽主席，每年都會來訪。

examples.en: Our host family was warm and hospitable to every guest.
examples.zh: 我們的寄宿家庭對每一位客人都親切又好客。

examples.en: The villagers are hospitable and always offer tea to visitors.
examples.zh: 村民很好客，總是請遊客喝茶。

examples.en: The desert is not a hospitable place for most plants.
examples.zh: 沙漠對大多數植物來說不是適宜生長的地方。

examples.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality during our stay.
examples.zh: 謝謝你們在我們住宿期間的熱情款待。

examples.en: Taiwanese people are famous for their hospitality to tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣人以對觀光客的好客而聞名。

examples.en: My sister studies hospitality management and wants to run a hotel.
examples.zh: 我姊姊讀餐旅管理，想經營一間旅館。

examples.en: The doctor decided to hospitalize him for a few days.
examples.zh: 醫師決定讓他住院幾天。

examples.en: She was hospitalized after she fell from her bike.
examples.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來後被送醫住院。

examples.en: Hospitalize the patient if the fever does not go down.
examples.zh: 如果發燒沒有退，就讓病人住院。

examples.en: A helicopter began to hover over the school playground.
examples.zh: 一架直升機開始在學校操場上空懸停。

examples.en: Bees hover around the flowers in the garden every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，蜜蜂都會在花園的花朵旁懸停。

examples.en: The waiter hovered near our table, waiting for us to order.
examples.zh: 服務生在我們桌子旁徘徊，等著我們點餐。

examples.en: The drone stayed in a hover above the field.
examples.zh: 無人機在田野上方保持懸停。

examples.en: The bird went into a hover before it dived for the fish.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥先懸停在空中，然後俯衝去抓魚。

examples.en: The camera drone maintained a steady hover while filming the farm.
examples.zh: 攝影無人機在拍攝農場時保持穩定懸停。

examples.en: The coach never tries to humiliate players who make mistakes.
examples.zh: 教練從不會讓犯錯的球員難堪。

examples.en: She felt humiliated when everyone laughed at her accent.
examples.zh: 大家嘲笑她的口音時，她覺得很丟臉。

examples.en: It is wrong to humiliate someone in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 在全班面前讓人丟臉是不對的。

examples.en: I have a hunch that it will rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我有預感今天下午會下雨。

examples.en: He followed his hunch and took the earlier train.
examples.zh: 他憑著直覺搭了較早的那班火車。

examples.en: Her hunch about the new student turned out to be right.
examples.zh: 她對那位新同學的直覺後來證明是對的。

examples.en: Don't hunch over your desk when you write.
examples.zh: 寫字的時候不要趴在桌上駝著背。

examples.en: He hunched his shoulders against the cold wind.
examples.zh: 他縮起肩膀抵擋寒風。

examples.en: The cat hunched on the sofa and watched the bird outside.
examples.zh: 貓縮著身子蹲在沙發上，看著外面的鳥。

examples.en: Passing the English test was the biggest hurdle for him.
examples.zh: 通過英文考試是他最大的難關。

examples.en: Our team jumped over the first hurdle when we got the funding.
examples.zh: 我們拿到經費時，團隊就跨過了第一道難關。

examples.en: She won the 100-meter hurdles at the school sports day.
examples.zh: 她在學校運動會上贏得了一百公尺跨欄。

examples.en: The runner hurdled the fence and kept going.
examples.zh: 那名跑者跨過柵欄繼續往前跑。

examples.en: The horse hurdled a low wall at the end of the field.
examples.zh: 那匹馬跨過了田野盡頭的矮牆。

examples.en: She hurdled every obstacle on the way to her goal.
examples.zh: 她克服了通往目標路上的每一個障礙。

examples.en: A mule is a hybrid of a horse and a donkey.
examples.zh: 騾是馬和驢雜交而成的混種。

examples.en: My father drives a hybrid to save money on gas.
examples.zh: 我爸爸開油電混合車來節省油錢。

examples.en: This fruit is a hybrid of an orange and a grapefruit.
examples.zh: 這種水果是柳橙與葡萄柚的混種。

examples.en: Our company offers a hybrid work plan with two office days.
examples.zh: 我們公司提供每週進辦公室兩天的混合辦公方案。

examples.en: The farmer planted a hybrid rice that grows quickly.
examples.zh: 農夫種了一種生長快速的混種稻米。

examples.en: The school is trying a hybrid class with both online and in-person lessons.
examples.zh: 學校正在嘗試線上與實體並行的混合式課程。

examples.en: Washing your hands is a basic part of good hygiene.
examples.zh: 洗手是良好衛生習慣的基本一環。

examples.en: The restaurant was closed because of poor hygiene in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 那間餐廳因廚房衛生不佳而停業。

examples.en: Teachers remind children about dental hygiene every semester.
examples.zh: 老師每學期都會提醒孩子注意口腔衛生。

examples.en: He is a hypocrite because he tells others to save water but wastes it himself.
examples.zh: 他是個偽君子，叫別人節約用水，自己卻浪費水。

examples.en: Don't be a hypocrite and do what you tell others to do.
examples.zh: 別當偽君子，要做到你要求別人做的事。

examples.en: She called him a hypocrite after he broke the rule he made.
examples.zh: 他違反了自己訂的規定，她就說他是個言行不一的人。

examples.en: Street lamps illuminate the road at night.
examples.zh: 路燈在夜晚照亮馬路。

examples.en: Candles illuminated the small room during the power outage.
examples.zh: 停電時，蠟燭照亮了這間小房間。

examples.en: The teacher used a simple example to illuminate the difficult idea.
examples.zh: 老師用一個簡單的例子來闡明這個困難的觀念。

examples.en: The weather report says that a typhoon is imminent.
examples.zh: 氣象報告說颱風即將來臨。

examples.en: The company is in imminent danger of closing its doors.
examples.zh: 這家公司正面臨迫在眉睫的倒閉危機。

examples.en: With the exam imminent, the students stayed up late to study.
examples.zh: 考試迫在眉睫，學生們熬夜讀書。

senses.zh: 絕對必要的；祈使語氣的

examples.en: It is imperative that you arrive on time for the interview.
examples.zh: 你務必準時到達面試現場。

examples.en: Getting enough sleep is imperative before a big exam.
examples.zh: 大考前睡眠充足是絕對必要的。

examples.en: In grammar class, we studied the imperative form of verbs.
examples.zh: 在文法課上，我們學了動詞的祈使語氣。

examples.en: Saving energy has become an imperative for every family.
examples.zh: 節約能源已成為每個家庭的當務之急。

examples.en: The first imperative for the new manager is to build trust.
examples.zh: 新經理的當務之急是建立信任。

examples.en: Safety is a moral imperative in any workplace.
examples.zh: 安全是任何職場的道德要務。

examples.en: There was an implicit promise in his smile.
examples.zh: 他的微笑裡有一個不言明的承諾。

examples.en: The rules are implicit, so new students must watch and learn.
examples.zh: 規則並未明說，所以新生必須觀察學習。

examples.en: She has implicit trust in her best friend.
examples.zh: 她對最好的朋友有絕對的信任。

examples.en: The old castle is an imposing building on the hill.
examples.zh: 那座古堡是山丘上一棟宏偉的建築。

examples.en: The principal is a tall and imposing man.
examples.zh: 校長是個高大又很有氣勢的人。

examples.en: The imposing mountain stood above the quiet village.
examples.zh: 巍峨的高山矗立在寧靜的村莊上方。

examples.en: The judge decided to imprison the thief for two years.
examples.zh: 法官決定將小偷監禁兩年。

examples.en: The storm imprisoned us in the cabin for three days.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓我們被困在小木屋裡三天。

examples.en: No one should be imprisoned without a fair trial.
examples.zh: 沒有人應該未經公正審判就被監禁。

examples.en: I incline to agree with your plan.
examples.zh: 我傾向同意你的計畫。

examples.en: The teacher inclined her head to listen to the little girl.
examples.zh: 老師微微側頭，聽那個小女孩說話。

examples.en: Bad weather inclined us to stay home this weekend.
examples.zh: 天氣不好，使我們這個週末想待在家裡。

examples.en: The bus slowly climbed the steep incline.
examples.zh: 公車緩緩爬上陡峭的斜坡。

examples.en: There is a gentle incline behind the school.
examples.zh: 學校後面有一個平緩的斜坡。

examples.en: Cyclists find the incline on this road hard to ride.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人覺得這條路上的斜坡很難騎。

examples.en: The price is inclusive of breakfast and tax.
examples.zh: 這個價格包含早餐與稅金。

examples.en: We want to build an inclusive school for all children.
examples.zh: 我們想為所有孩子打造一所包容的學校。

examples.en: The tour price is inclusive of all meals and transport.
examples.zh: 這趟旅遊的價格包含所有餐點與交通費。

examples.en: You will incur a late fee if you return the book after Friday.
examples.zh: 如果你星期五之後才還書，就會被罰逾期費。

examples.en: The company incurred heavy losses last year.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年蒙受了嚴重的虧損。

examples.en: Students who skip class may incur the anger of the teacher.
examples.zh: 翹課的學生可能會招致老師的怒氣。

examples.en: His indifference to the problem made his teammates angry.
examples.zh: 他對這個問題漠不關心，讓隊友很生氣。

examples.en: She looked at the price with indifference and bought it anyway.
examples.zh: 她毫不在乎地看了價格，還是買下它。

examples.en: The government cannot show indifference to the needs of the poor.
examples.zh: 政府不能對窮人的需求冷漠以對。

examples.en: She was indignant when the waiter ignored her order.
examples.zh: 服務生不理會她的點餐，讓她很憤慨。

examples.en: The customers were indignant about the high prices.
examples.zh: 顧客對高昂的價格感到憤憤不平。

examples.en: He wrote an indignant letter to the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 他寫了一封憤慨的信給校刊。

examples.en: Some medicine can induce sleep within thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 有些藥物能在三十分鐘內使人入睡。

examples.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
examples.zh: 什麼都無法讓他改變心意。

examples.en: The doctor may induce labor if the baby is late.
examples.zh: 如果寶寶遲遲不出生，醫師可能會引產。

examples.en: The flu is an infectious disease that spreads quickly in schools.
examples.zh: 流感是一種傳染病，在學校裡擴散得很快。

examples.en: Stay home if you are infectious, so you don't make others sick.
examples.zh: 如果你會傳染，就待在家裡，免得讓別人生病。

examples.en: Her laugh is infectious, and everyone in the room began to smile.
examples.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，房間裡的每個人都笑了起來。

examples.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on the small town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對這座小鎮造成了嚴重的破壞。

examples.en: Bad weather can inflict huge losses on farmers.
examples.zh: 惡劣天氣可能讓農夫蒙受巨大的損失。

examples.en: Please don't inflict your bad mood on your coworkers.
examples.zh: 請不要把你的壞心情強加在同事身上。

examples.en: Many kinds of birds inhabit the wetlands near our school.
examples.zh: 許多種鳥類棲息在我們學校附近的溼地。

examples.en: About two thousand people inhabit this island.
examples.zh: 大約有兩千人居住在這座島上。

examples.en: The old house has been inhabited by the same family for years.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子多年來一直由同一家人居住。

examples.en: The students protested against the injustice of the new rule.
examples.zh: 學生們抗議新規定的不公平。

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of injustice when she lost the job.
examples.zh: 她丟掉工作時，心中有強烈的不公平感。

examples.en: Teachers should not ignore injustice in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師不應該漠視教室裡的不公平現象。

examples.en: We stayed in an inland town far from the coast.
examples.zh: 我們住在一座遠離海岸的內陸小鎮。

examples.en: The inland areas of the island are much hotter in summer.
examples.zh: 這座島內陸地區的夏天熱得多。

examples.en: We took an inland road to avoid the crowded coast.
examples.zh: 我們走內陸的道路，避開擁擠的海岸。

examples.en: The storm moved inland after it hit the coast.
examples.zh: 暴風雨登陸海岸後往內陸移動。

examples.en: We drove inland for two hours to reach the lake.
examples.zh: 我們往內陸開了兩個小時才到達那座湖。

examples.en: The farmers moved inland to find better land.
examples.zh: 農夫們遷往內陸去尋找更好的土地。

examples.en: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中有無數的星星。

examples.en: The museum has innumerable paintings from different countries.
examples.zh: 這間博物館收藏了來自不同國家的無數畫作。

examples.en: She has asked me innumerable questions about the trip.
examples.zh: 她針對這趟旅行問了我數不清的問題。

examples.en: At her insistence, we stopped for lunch.
examples.zh: 在她的堅持下，我們停下來吃午餐。

examples.en: His insistence on honesty made him a good leader.
examples.zh: 他對誠實的堅持讓他成為一位好領導者。

examples.en: They came to the meeting because of the manager's insistence.
examples.zh: 由於經理堅決要求，他們來參加了會議。

examples.en: A baby's crying is an instinctive way of asking for help.
examples.zh: 嬰兒哭泣是出於本能的求助方式。

examples.en: Her instinctive reaction was to step back from the dog.
examples.zh: 她的直覺反應是從那隻狗身邊退開。

examples.en: He has an instinctive feeling for music.
examples.zh: 他對音樂有天生的直覺。

examples.en: Doctors say you should lower your sugar intake.
examples.zh: 醫師說你應該減少糖分攝取量。

examples.en: A sharp intake of breath told me she was surprised.
examples.zh: 她倒抽一口氣，我就知道她嚇了一跳。

examples.en: The college has a large intake of new students each fall.
examples.zh: 這所大學每年秋天都招收大量新生。

examples.en: The professor is known for his sharp intellect.
examples.zh: 那位教授以敏銳的才智聞名。

examples.en: Reading a wide range of books helps develop a child's intellect.
examples.zh: 廣泛閱讀各類書籍有助於發展孩子的智力。

examples.en: She is a woman of great intellect and humor.
examples.zh: 她是一位才智過人又幽默的女性。

examples.en: Turn left at the next intersection and you will see the bank.
examples.zh: 在下一個十字路口左轉，你就會看到那間銀行。

examples.en: There was a long traffic jam at the busy intersection.
examples.zh: 那個繁忙的十字路口塞了很長的車。

examples.en: The intersection of the two lines is point A.
examples.zh: 這兩條線的交點是 A 點。

examples.en: The teacher had to intervene when the two boys began to argue.
examples.zh: 兩個男孩開始爭吵時，老師必須出面介入。

examples.en: The government decided to intervene in the housing market.
examples.zh: 政府決定干預房市。

examples.en: Don't intervene unless your friends ask for your help.
examples.zh: 除非朋友請你幫忙，否則不要插手。

examples.en: The close friends shared a deep intimacy built over many years.
examples.zh: 這些好友之間有著多年來建立的深厚情誼。

examples.en: A small dinner table creates a feeling of intimacy.
examples.zh: 小餐桌能營造出親密的氛圍。

examples.en: Trust is the key to intimacy in any relationship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何關係中親密感的關鍵。

examples.en: The tall boy tried to intimidate the new student.
examples.zh: 那個高個子男孩試圖嚇唬新來的同學。

examples.en: Don't let the large crowd intimidate you during your speech.
examples.zh: 演講時別讓龐大的人群讓你害怕。

examples.en: Some people feel intimidated by difficult math problems.
examples.zh: 有些人會被困難的數學題嚇到。

examples.en: Rising intonation often shows that a speaker is asking a question.
examples.zh: 上揚的語調通常表示說話者在發問。

examples.en: Our English teacher helped us practice correct intonation.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師幫助我們練習正確的語調。

examples.en: The actor's intonation made the simple sentence sound funny.
examples.zh: 那位演員的語調讓這個簡單的句子聽起來很好笑。

examples.en: The strange old map began to intrigue the children.
examples.zh: 那張奇怪的舊地圖引起了孩子們的好奇。

examples.en: Stories about space always intrigue me, especially those about distant planets.
examples.zh: 關於太空的故事總是讓我很感興趣，尤其是那些談論遙遠行星的故事。

examples.en: She was intrigued by the unusual name on the door.
examples.zh: 門上那個不尋常的名字引起了她的好奇心。

examples.en: The movie is full of intrigue and surprising turns.
examples.zh: 這部電影充滿陰謀與出人意料的轉折。

examples.en: There was office intrigue before the new manager was chosen.
examples.zh: 在新經理選出之前，辦公室裡有些明爭暗鬥。

examples.en: The old house has an air of intrigue that attracts visitors.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子帶有一種吸引訪客的神祕感。

examples.en: Her advice was invaluable to me during the exam period.
examples.zh: 考試期間，她的建議對我來說非常寶貴。

examples.en: A dictionary is an invaluable tool for language learners.
examples.zh: 字典對語言學習者來說是非常寶貴的工具。

examples.en: The volunteers gave invaluable help after the storm.
examples.zh: 志工們在暴風雨後提供了無價的協助。

examples.en: The shop is closed today because the staff are taking inventory.
examples.zh: 店員正在盤點，所以這家店今天休息。

examples.en: We have a large inventory of winter coats at the store.
examples.zh: 我們店裡有大量的冬季外套庫存。

examples.en: The inventory lists every item currently stored in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 存貨清單列出目前存放在倉庫裡的每一件物品。

examples.en: It is ironic that the fire station caught fire.
examples.zh: 消防局竟然失火，真是諷刺。

examples.en: Her ironic smile showed that she did not believe him.
examples.zh: 她諷刺的微笑顯示她不相信他。

examples.en: The teacher made an ironic comment about my messy desk.
examples.zh: 老師針對我凌亂的桌子說了一句帶諷刺的話。

examples.en: I get irritable when I don't have enough sleep.
examples.zh: 我睡眠不足的時候會變得易怒。

examples.en: The baby was irritable because he was hungry.
examples.zh: 寶寶因為肚子餓而煩躁不安。

examples.en: My father is often irritable after a long day at work.
examples.zh: 我爸爸工作一整天後常常很煩躁。
